Project overview

A small off-plan villa project of six units in Thep Krasattri, Thalang, reported by FazWaz as 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom villas of about 262 sqm. Very little verified detail is available.

  • The Manour is a villa in Si Sunthon, Phuket.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 262 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
